subject: website
name: ENSjs documentation
summary: The documentation of @ensdomains/ensjs, source public in ensdomains/ensjs. It is not Level 3: the page sets a base URL of https://ensjs.ens.eth.link, so its scripts and styles load from the eth.link gateway, another host, with no integrity hash, instead of from the files the ENS name points to.

connections.name: eth.link gateway (ensjs.ens.eth.link)
connections.note: Serves the page's scripts, styles and logo through a base URL.
